unresolved_requirements.detail: Verify the newly specified local D formula, incumbent/challenger regions, baseline/excess convention, integration weights and weak-signal handling.
Verify the newly specified native raised-cosine cue, support clipping and two challenger-zone conventions. External pilot geometry and numerical results are unavailable and are not reproduced claims.
Verify exact sampled commanded area, including clipping and dynamic Spring geometry. Use literal native peak times 3.8; Spring native peak times .1.
Qualify new exact-L19/23/27/31/35/39 Holmes basals; the retained series contains different lengths.
Qualify exact Spring resting lengths Lchemical/15, with cue widths scaled by 1/38. This is a declared comparison convention, not optical/biological calibration.
Declare native duration brackets, model-specific recovery/horizons, resolution and local success/failure scans; bisection alone does not establish global monotonicity.
Specify cue width/peak and event semantics. Keep exact restart states, realized total ON and full off histories; zero-gap physical duplicates require exact validation before reuse.
Declare realization of pulse/gap schedules on the native half-unit lattice; no unreported rounding or off-lattice output is allowed.
Specify both weak levels, law/channel, mean, spatial/temporal correlations, activation windows, seeds, pulse count/total ON and retention criterion for linear WP/deBelly.
Declare full native-field archive cadence, per-model recovery periods, finite-tail windows/scales/tolerances and event/sample output checks.
Run new local separation, share/dwell withdrawal and initiation overlays. The reported external 102 assays are unavailable and provide no verified evidence.
Select exact length pair and assay contrasts per model; qualify 401-cell initial states, output sampling, solver sensitivity and deBelly lattice checks.
Measure a bounded new-protocol pilot before full native submission; historical resource figures are not an upper bound.

native_wrapper_recommendations.gates: gates() is prior orientation-based evidence only; new D fate gate requires its exact pilot definition.
native_wrapper_recommendations.chemical: Native BDF for Wave-pinning/Goryachev/Holmes; preserve native parameters and declare switching max_step.
native_wrapper_recommendations.spring: Native LSODA, rtol=2e-7, atol=2e-9, max_step=2.5; preserve raw u/v/boundaries and stretching. Existing output capture assumes one segment.
native_wrapper_recommendations.debelly: Corrected independent endpoints, center_boundary_motion=False, original staggered update step=0.5; preserve all coupled fields.
native_wrapper_recommendations.noise: Existing ring noise wrappers supply provenance patterns only; they do not implement linear deBelly noise.
